Vana, the forest - lume, the light
Vanalume is the glow of the forest carried indoors, the warmth of a living flame, the calm of green, the quiet luminosity that lingers long after the day has gone
Quiet, warm, restrained, no neon, no glitter, no floral candle clichés
To create thoughtfully crafted fragrance experiences that inspire slower, calmer and more intentional living
To build a global lifestyle brand where fragrance, design and ritual come together to transform everyday spaces into meaningful experiences

about.value: Built with patience, purpose and a belief that everyday rituals deserve beautiful design.

value.text: Vanalume was founded with a simple belief: the spaces we live in shape the way we feel. What began as an exploration of fragrance has grown into a vision for a lifestyle brand centred around composed living.

Every product is created with care, balancing thoughtful design, quality craftsmanship and sensory experiences. Rather than following trends, Vanalume seeks to create timeless pieces that become part of everyday rituals.
This journey is being built by founders who believe luxury is defined not by excess, but by meaning, simplicity and lasting experiences.

value.name: Nishant Sharma
value.bio: Nishant is a Business Management student at Shiv Nadar University, a competitive cricketer and a trained musician. He draws on the quiet balance between performance and creativity, guided by patience, precision and purpose. Vanalume grew from a simple idea of his: to create everyday moments people can truly feel.

value.name: Dr. Alok Sharma
value.bio: Dr. Alok Sharma is an eminent renal pathologist and researcher, and a lifelong maker at heart. He brings scientific rigour, creative instinct and a genuine respect for good craftsmanship. For him, Vanalume is thoughtful precision: everyday objects, made well, that bring lasting warmth into ordinary moments.

value.name: Dr. Bharati Malhotra
value.bio: Dr. Bharati Malhotra is a senior radiologist and a lifelong artist. She believes the spaces we create and the objects we choose quietly shape how we feel. For her, Vanalume is composed living: slowing down, living with intention and finding beauty in everyday rituals.

about.value: We are not building products, we are creating rituals worth returning to
